test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Room, House, Shirt
solution:
The least possible venn diagram of the given statements is:

Some rooms are in House,

Some rooms are in hotels are other places as well.

Shirt is different.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30275bdb81a1730e92a92397dfc6852beda0a88ab69e663ead8fd66c20dcc091.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "option 4".**
